senses.gloss: , only in אֲסוּבֵי ינוקא (prob. fr. סב, סבא) to cause a new-born child to vomit by putting one’s finger into its month, to relieve it of phlegm; cmp. חָנַךְ.—
units: Sabb. 123ᵃ, v. Ar. s. v. (Ms. O., Alf., Ash. אסוכי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) [Rashi: to set an infant’s limbs aright, v. עָצַב Pi.—incongruous with the following אפיקטויזין …]. [Keth. 10ᵃ אסבוהו, מסבינן, v. סְבָא.]
